cards.title: Recovery meets a higher rate hurdle
cards.question: Can AI earnings growth outrun the rise in discount rates?
cards.prompt: Nov 13 AP: S&P +2.5% for week, Nasdaq +2.3%, despite Friday losses. FT Nov 13: 10Y near 5.14%, +28bp on week after October inflation. 7d rebound; 30d reset since October highs; 90d AI capex expansion. Hypothesis: higher discount rate, not confirmed end of AI demand. What is priced in: strong AI growth; disconfirm risk-premium thesis if yields ease and revisions improve. Analyze SOXX/RSP/IWM and rates. Sources https://apnews.com/article/12c1e8155fb85c3c7b09e058ed6d3c74 https://www.ft.com/content/7bebace2-dc87-410a-ae29-ffd9f3176def

cards.title: Broad recovery, narrow doubts
cards.question: Did risk appetite improve beyond megacap AI?
cards.prompt: AP Nov 13: S&P +2.5% weekly versus Russell +1.3%; Friday Nasdaq -0.9% versus Dow +0.1%. FT: bond yields jumped. 7d relief, 30d technology correction, 90d concentration. Hypothesis: rotation rather than universal risk-off. Test equal-weight breadth, HY credit spreads and SOXX relative strength. Disconfirm if breadth weakens with spreads widening. https://apnews.com/article/12c1e8155fb85c3c7b09e058ed6d3c74 https://www.ft.com/content/7bebace2-dc87-410a-ae29-ffd9f3176def

cards.title: Foundry sales are real; ROI is next
cards.question: Does silicon demand become profitable inference?
cards.prompt: Verified TSMC Nov 10: October revenue NT$586.89B, +59.7% year over year; Jan-Oct +43.3%. 7d concrete order proxy; 30d AI valuation reset; 90d growing inference demand and capacity investment. Hypothesis: TSMC/packaging/memory benefit while operators face cost pressure. Priced in: sustained AI orders. Disconfirm if foundry growth decelerates, customer utilization or gross margins fall. https://pr.tsmc.com/english/news/3349

cards.title: Contracts must turn into live megawatts
cards.question: Which 2026 capacity commitments deliver in 2027?
cards.prompt: 2026 infrastructure contracts and power reservations approach 2027 delivery. Previously reported CoreWeave Nov 10 backlog $132.5B and contracted >4.6GW vs active >1.7GW; independently check future filings before relying on progress. Hypothesis: conversion timing drives builder cash flow and optical/memory order timing. Priced in: large backlog; uncertain: deployment pace. Disconfirm if utilization and FCF accelerate or orders cancel. https://investors.coreweave.com/news/news-details/2026/CoreWeave-Reports-Strong-Third-Quarter-2026-Results/default.aspx

cards.title: November 17 is a guidance test
cards.question: Will AI platform guidance validate 2027 spending?
cards.prompt: Upcoming Nov 17 Nvidia earnings per company schedule, followed by 2027 hyperscaler budget and commissioning updates over 1-12 months. Bull: sustained order visibility, margins and delivery; bear: order delays, lower gross margins or financing constraints. High demand is widely expected; measure surprise versus guidance and estimates, not headlines. https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Sets-Conference-Call-for-Third-Quarter-Financial-Results/default.aspx

cards.title: Will suppliers beat builders on revisions?
cards.question: Can suppliers hold estimates while builders fund growth?
cards.prompt: Hypothesis carried from Nov 14; check Dec 14 and Feb 14. Compare TSMC/MU/COHR/LITE earnings revisions with CRWV/NBIS free cash flow, financing and commissioned MW, adjusting for valuation. Higher Treasury yields may affect both. Reject if supplier orders or estimates fall first, or builder cash conversion accelerates. Avoid daily price-chasing. Sources https://pr.tsmc.com/english/news/3349 https://www.ft.com/content/7bebace2-dc87-410a-ae29-ffd9f3176def
